description: Pinned, digest-verified toolchain and dependency sources for Material Router. download-dependencies.bat reads this file; nothing is downloaded from a URL that is not recorded here. Project npm dependencies are pinned by package-lock.json (npm ci verifies every package against the lockfile integrity hash), so they are listed here for audit only and are not separately fetched by the bat scripts.

node.purpose: JavaScript runtime needed to run npm and the build scripts.

winget.digestNote: winget installs from the MS Store/CDN and does not expose a stable archive digest; the portable zip below is the digest-verified fallback and the authoritative pinned artifact.

projectDependencies.verifyNote: npm ci refuses to install when a registry tarball does not match the lockfile integrity hash. Versions below are informational copies of the resolved lockfile state at authoring time.

policy: Never install code-signing certificates or signing material of any kind.
Never install machine-wide when a user-scoped path exists.
A digest mismatch fails closed: the download is deleted and the script exits non-zero.
